rows.Description: An OpenA2A Registry instance itself. There is one canonical registry: `did:opena2a:registry:opena2a.org`.
A naming authority (typically a domain) recognized as a root or delegated trust anchor.
A vetted publisher of one or more catalogued resources.
An autonomous agent (A2A or otherwise) registered with the Registry.
A generic AI tool catalogued in the Registry.
A large language model catalogued in the Registry.
